page_title: BOL 1-0 LAZ | Bologna v Lazio 03/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Federico La Penna lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+3' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) will replace Joshua Zirkzee.
90+2' Nikola Moro (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The possession of the ball – 50:50.
86' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Dan Ndoye (Bologna) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Ivan Provedel easily catches the ball.
81' It's time for a substitution. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) comes on in place of Felipe Anderson.
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Matteo Guendouzi will be replaced by Daichi Kamada (Lazio).
81' Substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers did his best and is replaced by Dan Ndoye (Bologna).
80' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) replacing Charalampos Lykogiannis.
80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Lewis Ferguson (Bologna), but the defence gets it clear.
74' Luis Alberto (Lazio) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
74' Stefan Posch (Bologna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Bologna have a corner.
73' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nikola Moro (Bologna) for Michel Aebischer.
72' Luis Alberto (Lazio) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
71' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
70' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:4.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
66' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) on the edge of the box.
66' A free kick is awarded to Bologna.
65' Luis Alberto (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Federico La Penna and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
64' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
63' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Lazio.
62' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' Lazio enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
60' Stefan Posch (Bologna) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Federico La Penna signals.
57' Substitution. Pedro is replaced by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio).
57' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Taty Castellanos is replaced by Ciro Immobile (Lazio).
56' Sam Beukema (Bologna) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
56' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
55' A lofted cross from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Bologna force a corner. They send men into the box.
55' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
54' Federico La Penna interrupts the game. One of the players from Lazio won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
51' PENALTY APPEAL after Taty Castellanos (Lazio) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
50' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
50' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
48' Substitution. Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) has come on for Adam Marusic.
48' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
46' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) was set free in the area by Joshua Zirkzee and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
46' The whistle blows and Federico La Penna starts the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) unleashes a first-time shot from the edge of the box which goes a few yards wide of the right post.
45' The shots on goal statistics – 0:1.
43' Pedro (Lazio) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
39' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well over the crossbar.
36' A precise low pass is received by Taty Castellanos (Lazio), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
35' Pedro (Lazio) attempts to discuss the decision with Federico La Penna, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
31' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
28' Dangerous play by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna). Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
26' The ball is cleared after Taty Castellanos (Lazio) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
25' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
24' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' A player from Lazio commits a rough challenge. Federico La Penna blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
18' You don't see this every day. Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner but his cross crashes against the post!
18' Luis Alberto (Lazio) will take the corner.
17' Adam Marusic (Lazio) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lazio.
17' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) commits a rough foul. Federico La Penna stops the game and makes a call.
16' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
15' Luis Alberto (Lazio) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
12' A long ball forward to Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is intercepted.
8' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the right post with his header. A stroke of luck for the goalkeeper!
2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lazio.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Lazio will take the kick-off.
Federico La Penna is the one to supervise the game today.
